name: Lightkeeper
source:
You're the Princess of Lumien, the Kingdom of Light. You find yourself waking up in a cold, dark lighthouse. With no memories of how you got there and no magic to defend yourself, you search through your new prison for anything to help your… predicament. 

[From [url=https://smilestrawbunny.itch.io/lightkeeper]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是光明王国卢米恩的公主。一觉醒来，你发现自己身处一座阴冷幽暗的灯塔之中。你既想不起自己是如何流落至此，也失去了用以防身的魔力，只能在这座囚禁你的新牢笼里四处搜寻，找寻任何能帮你摆脱眼下这番…困境的东西。

[摘自[url=https://smilestrawbunny.itch.io/lightkeeper]itch.io[/url]]
